SS-PROPERTY-REFS.Purpose: Implementation family of the reactive property-slot contract (M-PROPERTY-REF): Bind/Watch over reactive Behavior slots in Widget and FVP owners.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: IPropertyRef: abstract slot contract over a Behavior-typed reactive property, independent of owner kind.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: BindRef: subscribe to events of the behavior currently occupying the slot.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: WatchRef: persistent tracking with automatic resubscription when the slot behavior changes.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Behavior lifetime management — delegated to SS-RUNTIME-SERVICES.

Principles.PRIN-001: Bind and Watch are complementary: bind for current instance, watch for the slot itself.

Requirements.REQ-001: Replacing the behavior in a watched slot releases the old subscription before acquiring the new one.
Requirements.REQ-002: Bind/Watch use strong handlers for all owner types; each owner must end its subscriptions deterministically (WidgetTree.Unmount or ordinary FVP.ReleaseFvp).
